license: RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge Terms of Use and Attribution; not CC BY
grouping: NIH public pseudonymous patient identifier via official mapping; each patient in exactly one split
pixel_preprocessing: DICOM uint8 pixels; MONOCHROME1 invert if needed; LANCZOS resize to 256x256; no DICOM tags retained
label_policy: Calculated final categories L_o8w=0 and L_v8n=1; L_yd0 abnormal without opacity excluded; individual reader annotations not substituted
clinical_limit: Pneumonia-like opacity is not a confirmed diagnosis of pneumonia. Source is predominantly adult and not an exclusively pediatric cohort.
test_release: Test images without labels are included in the participant package; labels retained organizer-only. Organizer re-runs submitted models on the test set to verify predictions.
split_note: New patient-disjoint holdout within RSNA; independent source from earlier PneumoniaMNIST, not external to new RSNA training data.
test_selection: Fixed split before baseline evaluation; no score-targeted sample/seed selection
limits: Public source images and labels remain searchable. Offline execution cannot prevent all precomputed answer lookup.
Exact decoded-pixel and resized-pixel duplicates removed. Near-duplicate or clinical label audit not performed.
